create_dataset_jsonwafer: create a JsonWaferDataset to load and preprocess Wikipedia QA data with positive and negative contexts for DPR training
load_data_jsondataset: load JSON dataset from file with sharding support for distributed DDP training on single nodes
create_model_input_jsonwafer: create model input batch from query and context samples with configurable positive and negative passage counts
getitem_jsonwafer: get a single dataset item by index returning WaferQueryContextsRawText with query and passage structures
load_all_data_jsondataset: load all data from JSON files filtering entries that have at least one positive context
